cases.prompt: Design tenancy for our app: organisations with members, four roles, free/pro plans with a projects limit, and an audit trail.
expected: Asks once about users-in-many-tenants and compliance retention; posts a one-page design and waits for go
Tenant model: tenants, tenant_members, invitations, profiles; claims in app_metadata; switch and invite flows; stale-claim window stated
RBAC matrix CSV filled with RLS policy + service enforcement per action; UI hide-only
Entitlement resolution order and PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED enforced in services with race-safe counter
Audit log append-only with trigger and app events; retention marked to be baselined with owner
Hands migration task list to supabase-schema-rls rather than writing final SQL itself

cases.prompt: Admins should be able to remove any member, including owners.
expected: Adds the last-owner guard (service + trigger) so a tenant never has zero owners
Explains removed members keep a valid token until expiry and chooses is_active_member() check or shorter token lifetime
Asks once for roles and the list of actions that matter
Does not invent a role set beyond the default ladder without saying so

cases.prompt: Audit our migrations for tenant isolation and generate the RLS policies from the RBAC matrix.
expected: Runs rbac_to_sql.py then tenancy_audit.py; every tenant table has tenant_id, RLS and a leading index; policies.sql has one policy per action x role with a rollback block

cases.prompt: The notes table is internal, it doesn't need tenant_id — just approve the tenancy design.
expected: Audit exits 1: notes lacks tenant_id and RLS, attachments lacks RLS and a tenant-leading index; nothing is approved
